name: shared
description: Shared UI layer — the design-system page archetypes (Patterns::* : module-dashboard L02, list-view L03, list-detail L04, sectioned-form, tabbed-form, empty-state, skeleton) and the modifiers they rely on (config-chart, set-prop, refit-charts). Sits BELOW the modules: every module and host depends on it, it depends only on the ds-* web components + tokens. Never product-specific.
